ordering: ascending seed, then ascending sigma; no adaptive proposal or selection
budget_rule: Finish each paired seed across all sigmas; stop before next seed if elapsed plus 1.5 times slowest seed duration exceeds budget. Never select by reward or agreement. Setup and controls are outside sweep budget.

dataset.prompt: Exact upstream base-model format: question + space + Let's think step by step and output the final answer after "####". + newline
dataset.bounded_difference: 512 new-token cap versus upstream handler default 1024; record length censoring, do not remove capped examples.

simulation: Initial shared prefix only. After first rejection emit corrected candidate token and decode remainder ordinarily. No suffix rejoining, no bonus token, no free base drafting claimed. A verification block is one ideal output round, not one-token wall cost. Prefill excluded symmetrically.
controls: Exact base hash and full bitwise restoration per candidate; zero-sigma output control; base output repeats before/after sweep; first nonzero candidate repeated after sweep. Prefix caching disabled and requests drained before mutation.

verifier_gate.rule: At least one common (sigma, k) must meet all thresholds on BOTH workloads with passing controls and a completed bounded sweep. This is a predeclared engineering screen, not a statistical test or evidence of speedup. Other sigma results remain reported.
